data.title: Gilead: Strong HIV and Oncology Growth Underpins Reiterated Buy Rating and Unchanged $165 Price Target
data.description:
Michael Okunewitch, an analyst from Maxim Group, reiterated the Buy rating on Gilead Sciences. The associated price target remains the same with $165.00.

Claim 55% Off TipRanks

  • Unlock powerful investing tools with TipRanks Premium to make smarter, more confident investment decisions

Michael Okunewitch has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors centered on Gilead’s strong operating performance and upgraded outlook. The company exceeded second-quarter expectations on both revenue and adjusted earnings, driven largely by robust growth in its HIV treatment and prevention portfolio, particularly Biktarvy, Descovy, and the rapidly expanding PrEP business led by Yeztugo. Management raised its 2026 ex-Veklury revenue guidance, signaling faster base business growth, even as COVID-related sales decline.

In addition, Okunewitch highlights meaningful upside from oncology, with Trodelvy’s expansion into first-line breast cancer and a high-tier guideline endorsement positioning it for broader use. Recent acquisitions such as Arcellx and Tubulis add late-stage oncology assets, including exposure to the BCMA CAR-T market, which could further diversify and accelerate growth beyond HIV. Taken together, the durable HIV franchise, accelerating PrEP opportunity, and building oncology pipeline support his view that Gilead’s current valuation does not fully reflect its medium-term earnings and revenue potential, justifying a reiterated Buy and an unchanged $165 price target.

Okunewitch covers the Healthcare sector, focusing on stocks such as Kiora Pharmaceuticals, Citius Oncology, and Gilead Sciences. According to TipRanks, Okunewitch has an average return of -1.9% and a 37.01% success rate on recommended stocks.
